title: Main Window
purpose: The primary OpenKaava application window containing the pane grid, clusters, panels, and toolbars
states: initialized - shell is loading the stack snapshot
active - shell is fully ready with clusters and apps
empty-clusters - no clusters open in this window
rescanning - stack is being re-scanned for changes
acceptance: shall render title bar with window controls
shall render cluster bar showing active and inactive clusters
shall render pane grid with open apps when cluster is active
shall render terminal band at bottom when collapsed or expanded
shall render secondary panel on right when toggled open
shall render status bar at bottom
shall show 'No clusters' state when all clusters are closed
shall display loading state while stack is being scanned
